name: lieflat-less-ai-tone
title_zh: 只删清单上那七种AI腔，其余一字不动
tagline_zh: 成稿后过一遍，把「值得注意的是」「总的来说」这类机器惯用语揪出来改掉。不在清单里的句子原样放行，不重排段落。
tagline_en: Post-draft pass that catches only whitelisted AI tics like 'it's worth noting'—everything else stays exactly as.
desc_en: 按 SKILL.md 明确列出的规则识别并改写写作中的 AI 痕迹。只能处理清单内的问题；未命中规则的文字必须原样保留，也不能改变文章框架。适用于写作完成后的成稿清理。 Remove AI writing tells using an explicit whitelist of rules; leaves unmatched text untouched.
why_zh: 靠显式白名单而非模型直觉，改什么由你定死。规则透明可审计，不会自作主张把个人风格也当AI味洗掉。
why_en: Explicit whitelist instead of model vibes—you control exactly what gets edited. Auditable rules won't mistake your personal.
limit_zh: 只处理SKILL.md列出的规则；未命中文字原样保留。不识别清单外的AI痕迹，也不动文章框架。适合成稿清理。
limit_en: Only edits patterns listed in SKILL.md; unmatched text stays untouched. Won't catch off-list tells or restructure content. For final-pass cleanup.
title_en: Removes only whitelisted AI tells, leaves the rest untouched
